The change in `HTTPAdapter.request_url` now preserves the original path when it starts with `//`.

The issue has been fixed by modifying `src/requests/adapters.py`. The logic in `HTTPAdapter.request_url` was incorrectly normalizing S3-style paths that start with `//`. The fix ensures that if the URL path starts with `//`, it is preserved as is, preventing the incorrect transformation to `/key`.
